sections.heading: In-Game Description
sections.text:
The persimmon-like heart of a Great Serpent.
The Great Serpent is considered to be a god of the land, and the heart is believed to be where one's spirit resides. While its shape bears similarity to a persimmon, in fact this is the red viscera of a god. It is safe to assume that eating it would be poisonous to one's health.

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text:
The following steps are required to kill the Great Serpent:
- Meet the Serpent after the Gun Fort.
- Perform the Puppeteer Ninjutsu on the Rat of Senpou Temple to have him operate the Shinobi Kite.
- Use the Kite to reach the Sunken Valley Cave Sculptor's Idol.
- Execute a lunge deathblow on the Serpent and then final deathblow to murder it.
Required for the Return Ending.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text: - Even if the Great Serpent of the Sunken Valley is killed, the Great Serpent guarding the Dried Serpent Viscera will still be found in the cave.
